IncidentCategoryCustomerFriendlyDescript: We regularly inspect electrical equipment in your area to help keep your electricity supply safe and reliable. As part of this programme, we will be replacing and upgrading 34 electricity poles. These poles play an important role in helping us deliver a safe and reliable supply to homes and businesses. Following an unplanned power cut on the 12th of August 2026, we will also be trimming trees around sections of our overhead cables. To maintain your electricity supply during the work, we'll temporarily connect your property to a generator. If you have solar panels, please switch them off to keep them safely isolated. If your system has an 'island mode' (sometimes called backup or standby mode) you can use that instead. This helps prevent any issues during the power cut. This work is taking place in the High Street area.
